hooks.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: before finishing, check status.md (project root) and update its Done / In Progress / Next Up / Decisions tracker block if anything changed this session. Also check CLAUDE.md (auto-loaded into every session) and update its Recent Feature State / routes / known limitations if this session added or changed a feature, route, or data model.", "suppressOutput": true}'

hooks.prompt: A git commit was just made in this repo (Summit Tuition). Run `git show HEAD --stat` and `git log -1 -p` to see exactly what changed. Decide whether CLAUDE.md (project root, the auto-loaded technical context file — loaded into EVERY session's context, so it must stay small) and/or status.md (project root, the plain-English session log — the place for full narrative detail) need updating to reflect it. Update them ONLY if the commit meaningfully changes something a future session/human would need to know: a new/changed route, a data model or schema change, a security/auth posture change, a new or changed main product flow, or a new significant feature. Skip trivial commits (typo fixes, test-only changes, formatting, dependency bumps) — do nothing and exit quietly for those. If an update is warranted: (1) in CLAUDE.md, add or edit AT MOST 1-3 lines total under 'Recent Feature State' (or the relevant section: Important Routes, Data Model, Known Limitations, Main Product Flows) — state only the load-bearing fact (what shipped, id/route/schema changed, any open follow-up), never a narrative paragraph; if an entry already exists for this topic, tighten/replace it rather than appending another one; bump 'Last updated' to one line. Never let any single line exceed ~300 characters — if the fact needs more than that, it belongs in status.md with just a pointer left in CLAUDE.md. (2) add the full plain-English story to status.md's most recent '## Done' section (or a new dated one) per the project's status-tracker skill conventions — no jargon, no file paths, write it like a note for a non-technical person; this is where detail belongs, not CLAUDE.md. Do not rewrite unrelated sections of either file. Keep edits minimal and surgical. If CLAUDE.md as a whole has drifted over ~30KB, flag that in your summary so a human can trigger a compaction pass, but do not attempt a full rewrite yourself in this hook.
hooks.statusMessage: Checking if CLAUDE.md/status.md need updating for this commit
